Cakio: A lightweight camera kiosk: a thin client that only shows security cameras and is managed over SSH.
Eurotas: A local broadcast hub that encodes one source once and plays it in sync on every screen.
JinjaRender: A minimalist API that generates HTML from a Jinja template and a JSON file.
NetworkAutomationProject: Python, Ansible, and Bash that build a hub-and-spoke network of namespaces, bridges, and firewall rules.
RTFM: A zsh plugin that fuzzy-finds options, arguments, and paths from the real manual.
SAND: Turns spreadsheets into a DuckDB database with a local API, SQL, and chart-first answers.
Voidling: An immutable OS built from unchanged Void Linux packages, with atomic updates and rollback.
